# MLOps & LLMOps — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Registry + promotion

*Module 1: Model lifecycle · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_registry_and_promotion.py`): Define the promotion gates for one of your models (metrics, card, approver). Practise a rollback on a test endpoint and time it.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Version a RAG stack

*Module 2: LLMOps · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_version_a_rag_stack.py`): Write the manifest for your own LLM app. Change one thing (the prompt). Which evals must re-run before it ships? Who approves?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Dashboards + alerts

*Module 3: Monitoring · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_dashboards_and_alerts.py`): Define one alert in each of the four families for your system, each with an owner and a first action. An alert without a runbook line is noise.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Gateway design

*Module 4: Platform patterns · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_gateway_design.py`): Sketch your gateway: which policies are central (keys, logging, budgets, PII) and which stay with teams (prompts, evals)? What is your chargeback unit?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
